summary: Backend-only iteration44 quota regression completed against public preview API using pytest + Mongo fixture setup. Core daily UTC pools, watchdog enforcement, VIP/free transitions, room share tags, and notices serialization passed in automated coverage.
action_items: Optional: add deterministic server-midnight watchdog integration test harness (real clock boundary) to complement existing pure function tests.
Optional hardening: review passlib/bcrypt compatibility warning seen in backend logs to avoid future auth-runtime drift.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py seed_admin currently has ADMIN_PASSWORD fallback default ('Admin1234!'); this violates strict fail-fast env policy for secrets.
backend/routes/auth.py hardcodes EMERGENT_SESSION_URL; policy requires environment-driven URLs for portability and config safety.
Observed repeated backend warning: passlib bcrypt backend reads missing __about__.__version__ attribute (non-blocking today, but should be dependency-aligned).
seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA users with prefix qa_iter44_free_* for deterministic free-quota boundary tests, then removed them and their owned fixture data. Note: during cleanup, room_time_warnings was broadly cleared once; this may have removed pre-existing warning docs in preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coverage included: /api/rooms/time-allowance shape (VIP unlimited + free 7200), no ObjectId leakage, create ignores legacy host counter field, join/rejoin/heartbeat idempotency + nonmember heartbeat 403, listener/speaker/moderator in listener pool with host separate, owner-away hosting charge continuity, switch-room membership settling, kick/end interval stops and kick-ban behavior, private-share block, auto #voiceroom tagging + manual caption preservation, notices unread/list typed serialization including legacy notice docs, watchdog host/listener cap enforcement within seconds, warning once/day via real WS event capture, VIP expiry free_since behavior, and unit coverage for allowance_from midnight clipping/reset.
rca_of_issue: No failing backend quota defects found in this run. Earlier assertion failures were test-harness assumptions (room auto-close semantics and post-expiry overlap expectation), corrected to match implemented contract and revalidated with 15/15 passing.
